title: BhashaSutra: A Task-Centric Unified Survey of Indian NLP Datasets, Corpora, and Resources

bias_targets.methodology: Surveying and categorizing datasets, benchmarks, and embedding analyses that evaluate gender bias in Indian NLP systems and language models.
Reviewing benchmarks and studies that measure casteism and caste-based stereotypes in word embeddings and large language models.
Consolidating India-centric benchmarks that assess religious stereotypes and biases in language models.
Documenting datasets and evaluation frameworks designed to detect regional biases and disparities across different Indian languages and dialects.
Examining cross-cultural evaluation suites and benchmarks that test for socio-cultural prejudices and cultural alignment in language models.
Reviewing resources that evaluate span-level social biases, stereotypes, and social stigma within India-centric NLP models.
